player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Muteri {player_id} ekameni ra Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Simbolo yakwe yi '{symbol}'.
Tindzimo yi ku pfumelela ku va ni vutharu (hoxa, vinyuka, kuya hi ndlela ya diagonal).
Laha u endla vutharu, UHLERI.
Nyika swiviko swako swa ku heta kuya hi foromati '[4]' ku nyika simbolo yakwe eka seli 4.
Tani Muteri {player_id}, uyini '{symbol}' na ripfumelo rakwe yi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomete ya ku rhurha leyi nga tirhiki. Tirhisa '[cell]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Xikombo xa sele leyi nga tirhiki.

game_action.placed: Muteri {player_id} u hakele simbolo yakwe ({symbol}) eka seli {cell}.

outcome.loss: Muthlami {player_id} u hluleka hi ku hetisisa mstari!
outcome.draw: A ku na loyi a nga lahlekeriwa.
